model_type: Classical & Neural Computer Vision Pre-Processing Pipeline (OpenCV, Sharp/libvips, CLAHE, Adaptive Binarization, and Cylindrical Dewarping)
deployment_location: Pre-inference stage on Client (react-native-fast-opencv / Skia) or Server (Node.js Sharp / OpenCV)
privacy_compliance: 100% private and on-premise. Manipulates raw pixel arrays strictly in local memory with zero network exposure; fully compliant with HIPAA, GDPR, and Philippine DPA.
on_device_binary_size_impact: 0 MB if hosted on Node.js backend using Sharp. If bundled on mobile via native OpenCV C++ bindings, adds approximately 12 MB to 20 MB to the APK/IPA.
printed_label_accuracy: Indirect booster (+18% to +35% relative accuracy improvement). Eliminates shadow gradients, uneven illumination, and optical skew before the text engine runs.
handwriting_recognition: Indirect booster (+15% to +25% character recovery). CLAHE contrast enhancement and Sauvola adaptive thresholding recover faint ink strokes on carbon-copy prescription slips.
multilingual_code_switching_support: Language-agnostic. Operates exclusively at the optical signal and pixel geometry level, benefiting English, Filipino, and medical symbols equally.
curved_surface_and_glare_tolerance: Extremely High (Core Strength). Specular reflection suppression inverts glare hotspots on blister packs, while cylindrical dewarping unrolls 3D amber pill bottle curves into flat 2D planes.
tabular_timetable_parsing: High indirect benefit. Geometric deskewing and morphological grid-line extraction ensure horizontal lines remain parallel, preventing columnar crosstalk in discharge schedules.
hallucination_under_degraded_input: Zero generative risk. As a deterministic pixel transformation filter, it cannot fabricate words; it actively suppresses noise artifacts that cause OCR misfires.
latency_seconds: 0.04 to 0.35 seconds (40-350 ms) per 12MP downsampled image depending on whether classical filters (Sharp) or neural dewarping meshes (DocTr) are executed.
ram_peak_footprint: 60 MB to 160 MB during uncompressed RGBA pixel buffer manipulation.
cost_profile: 100% Free and open source (BSD / Apache 2.0). Zero operational licensing or recurring fees.
react_native_compatibility: Very High on backend (seamlessly wraps Node.js server/src/ocr.ts via Sharp). On mobile, react-native-fast-opencv or Skia provides accelerated canvas transformations.
offline_readiness: 100% offline. Operates completely without internet on any device.
structured_output_support: Non-applicable (Image-to-Image pipeline). Outputs a normalized, rectilinearly corrected, high-contrast bitmap for consumption by downstream OCR or VLM engines.
formulary_grounding_readiness: Indirect benefit. Cleaner character isolation significantly reduces OCR character substitution errors (e.g., '0' vs 'O', '1' vs 'l'), boosting PNDF dictionary hit rates.
